notes.title: Content Update # 4 (+7 Puzzles) Halloween Edition!
notes.notes:
Get ready for your Halloween romance, slash, adventure, slash, puzzle solving experience. This time apart from the new puzzles you will get to try the all brand new ability: Bat Swarm. Boo!

Features:

• +7 Halloween Puzzles in total (with DLC).
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35292816/8c814d1cfedbf9b36eb358f4ca94db08c8c5686b.png
• Say Hello to the new Skill tree
• +7 Images for each puzzle for Arts DLC holders
• +6 Halloween Achievements
• +1 New Ability: "Bat Swarm". It's super OP on higher levels. Not sure if it will not be nerfed soon...


Fixes:

• Bugs in how abilities parameters were displayed fixed

notes.title: Content Update # 2 (+5 NSFW Puzzles)
notes.notes:
Surprise Surprise! Another one of them cool updates. Well in this iteration of the game - some bugs were scrubbed out. Some new features introduced and more NSFW puzzles added for the owners of the FREE DLC - and images for the owners of the ARTS DLC.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35292816/1167d91c0c79f7c46a8a5dd7deec38efb3ee012e.png

In summary...

Features:

• Added 5 Puzzles to the FREE DLC
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35292816/cd520098e8f217b91203a3690c0c8c1307897f69.png

• Added Save Slots. You have now 3 save slots - you can delete your 
progress if you so wish
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35292816/7491fbcd99f52ad616bcc00fbc36482c723991e6.png

• Added Possibility to see achievements in game. You can check your progress
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35292816/dc216d7db7e1d3499af9eb2d511b2eacd85a90b1.png

Fixes:

• Chinese translation fixed
• Japanese translation fixed
• Mobile dialogue UI is slightly better. You can now slide the conversation screen and click anywhere to progress
• Slight graphics glitch: heart marker on blocks rotating with phones fixed
• Gallery is slightly more friendly to view - no problem with images being to big while zooming in and out. Also it centres on the image always while browsing
• Game gobbling up all computer memory and crashing the computer - fixed
• various small bugs fixed

Balance:

• Auto repeating "Soft Critical" on 20+ Level is not auto repeating anymore
• "Sweep Beacon" covers a wider area but gets less repeat waves

notes.title: Achievements Bug Fix
notes.notes: Version 1.0.0.0 did not unlock achievements at all. New version 1.0.0.1 unlocks all current achievements. All your previous achievements should unlock normally and no progress should be lost in any way.
